QuestInfo.name: End
QuestInfo.0: Will realized that his plan to keep #p2400005# and #p2400006# sealed in Mirror World was falling apart, so he tried one last, desperate measure. He plans to use the Goddess's powers to revert all time!
QuestInfo.1: After a hard-fought battle, #p2400005# and #p2400006# defeated Will. The Goddess awakened for a brief moment, long enough to transfer her powers to #p2400005# and #p2400006#, before she passed away. They decided to leave Mirror World in her memory, and head to their true home.
